Listened to a policy podcast blaming "lack of ambition" for low intra-African trade.

Moving a container from Mombasa to Kigali costs more than Guangzhou to Mombasa because of endless border shakedowns. Stop psychoanalyzing traders when the entire barrier is state extortion.
